content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"eq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"eq","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"fight"}},{"id":"navigate","priority":1,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"gte","value":0}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"reach-ladder"}}],"skills":[{"name":"reach-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const path = [[2,8],[3,8],[4,8],[5,8],[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { const p = await b.body(); if (p.x===x && p.y===y) continue; const r = await b.walkTo(x,y,'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk fail '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); await b.wait(150); } } }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x===11 && p.y===1, detail: 'at '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"},{"name":"fight","skill":"async (b) => { const ms = await b.monsters(); const p = await b.body(); let best=null, bd=1e9; for (const m of ms) { const d=Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y); if (d<bd){bd=d;best=m;} } if (!best) return; await b.selectSlot(0); await b.faceAndPress(best.x,best.y,'ControllerX'); await b.wait(150); }","check":"async (b) => ({ok:true, detail:'attacked'})"}]}
